scope: One manually selected literal per paper, with controlled synthetic evidence. This does not reproduce the authors' experiments or annotate every result in these papers.
selection_policy: Choose an explicit author-reported result or parameter with a short, unique surrounding context. Development source scans preceded annotation; held-out annotations were made from raw source before evaluator execution. No automatic mapping is evaluated.
